style: Crie uma prancha de ANIME 2D DE TELEVISÃO, como seis frames de uma animação shounen desenhada à mão. Visual de cel de animação tradicional, desenho limpo e deliberadamente simplificado. Contornos pretos nítidos. Cores VIVAS E CHAPADAS. Uma cor-base e UMA sombra de borda dura por superfície. Rostos fortemente estilizados de anime: olhos expressivos e gráficos, nariz pequeno desenhado com um traço, boca simples, cabelo em mechas/massas gráficas. Pele completamente lisa com apenas duas cores. Roupa com poucas linhas de dobra. Metal com dois tons planos e um único brilho desenhado. Fundos também desenhados e simples. PROIBIDO: semirrealismo, concept art realista, pintura digital, texturas, granulação, hachuras, poros, veias, rugas detalhadas, ferrugem, desgaste fotográfico, luz volumétrica, bokeh, gradientes de pele, render 3D, anatomia hiperdefinida. O resultado precisa parecer captura limpa de anime, não ilustração de fantasia com aparência real. Sem texto. Prancha EXATA 3 colunas x 2 linhas, 1536x1024, seis quadros quadrados iguais sem margens. All characters assigned to Inferno must read immediately as demonic or visibly infernal rather than ordinary humans, holy figures, or neutral civilians. Existing human features are identity anchors only: retain face, age, costume and signature props where possible, but translate them into a unique infernal silhouette and surface tied to their kingdom and kit. Use distinct cues instead of a single horned template; avoid gore. For every ability illustration, use infernal ghouls or identifiable protagonists, supporting characters, and enemies from the cast as targets. Never use generic armored soldiers; preserve the exact target count and show recognizable character silhouettes or ghouls. For Aristides, O Regulador, the art must use golden infernal energy and unique sigils only: no horns, physical balance scales, pans, weights, or pendulums.

characters.name: A Chama que Não Apaga
characters.design: Paraíso / Esperança. Stout 58-year-old woman with deep brown skin, broad nose, white coiled undercut, thick brows; amber work coat, indigo trousers, copper firekeeper gauntlet. Her power is a tiny tenacious blue-white ember preserved inside an old cracked miner lantern, not a fire humanoid.

side view swinging lantern to fling one white-hot coal at a dark training target
low view driving lantern hook upward, shower of sparks shatters a falling obstruction
kneeling, her copper-gauntlet hand anchors lantern into a rubble gap and warms the broken ground to hold it together
personal defense: crouches within close-fitting ember-lined coat, hostile blade skids off hardened glowing hem; no dome

kneels using warm inlaid pick as brace beside a fallen ally's boot, helping them regain footing
hops upward off prosthetic leg over a low blade, using pick as vault pole, motion sharply clear

Golden infernal energy and unique angular signs express his power; no physical balance scales, pans, weights, pendulums, halos, or saintly symbols. He is visibly demonic, never a normal man or holy judge.
